notes.title: Meet the Champions
notes.content:
[IMG]http://i.imgur.com/xnE3swZ.png[/IMG]

Dogs of War latest patch is live and it’s an almost complete reboot of the game. We removed all the little things that could made it frustrating to build your army : no more grinding to level up your units, no more injuries and most importantly, we made all the units much cheaper to acquire. And then, we added a new awesome game mode, “Confrontation”, a new unit type, the Champions, and many new features :

- 9 champions to lead your companies, including a free one for every faction
- 54 new basic units, “the troops”, each with a unique combination of stats, skills and attributes. 
- No more skill trees and no more grinding to level up units.
- Troops prices range from 40 to 250 ducats, much cheaper than previous units
- No more injuries from battle and no more healing cards to purchase
- A new game mode : “Confrontation”. Dominate the field, protect your 
Champion and destroy your opponent in this new and exciting mode mixing Deathmatch, King of the Hill and VIP
- New and improved friendly match interface now simpler and with even more options
- Refund of everything that you spent on the skill-tree units, shards of oblivion or healing cards. Check your account, some of you are probably very wealthy right now.

And a very special gift for all the players registered before the patch : 20 000 Ducats

No time to lose, the battle has begun...

notes.title: Patch 0.12.10 is live, come get your rewards !
notes.content:
Hey everyone, 

The patch 0.12.10 is live and our servers are running smoothly again, it's time to come and check all the new features and especially the new level-up rewards. 
Every time you'll reach a new level you'll get ducats, healing cards and colors for your units. 
And if you already passed a few level, when you'll log into the game you'll get all the rewards you missed. No time to lose, launch the game to collect your prize and improve your company.

But this is not the only change. We listened to your complaints about the reduced maps with invisble walls and we replaced them by larger maps with borders (you were right, it's much better with borders). 
We also improved the friend sponsoring feature. It's now much easier to find and to use and the rewards are better. Just go to your profil page to start inviting your friends.
Among the many other changers, we increased the XP earned by your units in training games, changed the score goals in KOTH because games were too fast and much more...

We hope you'll enjoy these changes. 
No more reading, it's battle time !

[IMG]http://i.imgur.com/P8NFwX2.png[/IMG]
